description.value: The Village Burgery is a burger-focused fast food spot situated in Steveston, the historic fishing village at the southwestern tip of Richmond that draws visitors year-round. Steveston's waterfront and dyke trail system make it a popular destination on regional cycling routes, and a quick-service burger stop near the harbour is a natural refuelling point. The business was OSM-verified as of mid-2024.
